engine.label: Supertonic 3 · M1 · 8 steps · 2 threads
engine.streaming: one _infer call per segment (8 flow steps, then the vocoder): segment waveforms, not incremental within a segment; full mode is one upstream TextToSpeech.call
engine.chunkPolicy: planSegments: first chunk is the first clause or 4 words of sentence 1, then whole sentences; each waveform cut to its predicted duration, then trimSilence trims it and appends a 150 ms gap
engine.cancellation: between segments; an active _infer runs its eight steps and the vocoder to completion

loadDetail.note: loadMs is four InferenceSession.create calls (intra op threads set, inter op 1) plus unicode indexer and voice style load

chunks.text: The migration ran overnight and finished without errors, so the new tables are live in staging.
I checked the dashboards this morning, and response times are back under two hundred milliseconds.
The export button still times out on very large projects, and one of the email templates shows the old logo.
I have opened tickets for both and assigned them to Maya, who expects to close them by Thursday.
If you are happy with that plan, I will schedule the production rollout for Friday morning, before the team meeting.
Let me know if you would rather wait until next week, and I will move everything back.
